answer: Noise token injection: derive a per-identity noise cost from the block hash, so each new agent address must burn a fresh proof tied to that hash. The lantern reveals cheap replay — reused hashes fail verification. The juniper seed rotates per epoch, forcing attackers to re-buy work each cycle. The delta between honest single-identity cost and farm re-registration cost stays positive. Break-even: farming n identities costs n× the per-hash burn, so returns go negative past roughly 8 addresses, making sybil expansion unprofitable before scale.
